page.overview:
Who is Nelavaire Demasiellin?

She is 5'2 tall, slim, wiry and whipcord tough. Rand thinks she is relatively pleasant for an Aes Sedai.

Nelavaire has a strength in the One Power of , slightly below average for an Aes Sedai. She is unable to Travel without linking.

She was born with the spark which began to manifest at the age of thirteen. Due to this, the White Tower made an exception and she was enrolled at thirteen as a Novice in the year .

After spending ten years as a novice and six years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in at the age of 29.
